title: Source audit and research notes
description: Verify the legacy prototype's citations, survey ISL datasets and published results, and record assumptions. Output: RESEARCH_NOTES.md, dataset-evaluation.md and the JSON files in research/data.

title: Close open verification gaps
description: Re-open the sources that could not be read (Mendeley Data records, ISLRTC dictionary site, data.gov.in catalogue, Kaggle pages, FDMSE-ISL download page) from a network that can reach them, and record licences exactly as stated.

title: ISL sign inventory with a fluent signer
description: Fix the class list for the first experiment (letters and digits), marking each sign as one-handed, two-handed, or motion-dependent, checked against the ISLRTC dictionary and reviewed by a fluent ISL signer.

title: Consent-based landmark data collection
description: Collect MediaPipe landmark samples (not raw video) for the static inventory from multiple signers with informed consent, storing an anonymous signer ID with every sample so signer-aware splits are possible.

title: Dual-hand feature extractor
description: Implement and unit-test the normalisation and coordinated dual-hand feature vector shared by training and browser inference. The browser extractor for schema rtslr-features-1 (63-D per hand, 156-D for two hands, docs/MODEL_CONTRACTS.md) exists in frontend/src/features/tracking/features.ts. Still open: comparing it with the 158-value dualhand-v1 proposal in RESEARCH_NOTES.md (EXP-004). No experiment has evaluated either layout.

title: EXP-001 detection feasibility on two-handed signs
description: Measure how often MediaPipe returns both hands for each two-handed ISL sign, before any classifier work.

title: EXP-002 to EXP-004 static classifier experiments
description: Train k-NN and MLP baselines on the dual-hand features, compare random and signer-independent protocols, and run the feature ablation. Results go to rtslr-experiments.json only after they are actually run.

title: EXP-005 browser latency measurement
description: Measure end-to-end per-frame latency and frame rate of landmarking plus classification in target browsers and devices.

title: Sequence model baseline on a public word-level ISL dataset
description: Extract landmark sequences from a permissively licensed word-level dataset (INCLUDE-50 is the leading candidate) and train a small sequence model, reusing the dataset's official split and reporting the protocol.

title: Motion-dependent letters and sign segmentation
description: Handle letters that need motion and decide how sign boundaries are detected in a live stream.

title: Body and face cues
description: Evaluate adding pose and face landmarks for signs whose meaning depends on location on the body or on non-manual features, and measure the browser cost.

title: Deaf community review
description: Have fluent ISL signers review the sign inventory, the recognition behaviour and the wording of every accuracy claim before public release.
